name: Reloaded | 1.1g Infused Preroll | Bomboclaat Berry
description:
RELOADED – INFUSED 1G PRE-ROLL

High Caliber Infusion for Heavy Hitters

Lock. Load. Elevate. Introducing Reloaded – a premium 1-gram pre-roll engineered for those who don’t just smoke—they ignite. Expertly rolled with top-shelf flower and injected with potent distillate for a next-level experience, Reloaded delivers a clean, powerful high that hits harder, lasts longer, and burns smoother.

This isn’t your average pre-roll. This is high-performance cannabis, precision-infused for the seasoned smoker who demands more than just a buzz. Whether you're lighting up to unwind or blasting off to new dimensions, Reloaded is locked and ready to fire.

Features:

1g pre-roll of premium, hand-selected flower
Precision-injected with high-potency distillate
Slow, even burn with maximum flavor and intensity
Designed for seasoned smokers seeking full-throttle effects
Reloaded – because average isn’t in your arsenal.
